summary.zh: 分布最广的非人灵长类之一，与人类共享约 93% 的 DNA 序列。
summary.en: One of the widest-ranging non-human primates, sharing roughly 93% sequence identity with humans.

field_marks.zh: 黄褐至灰褐色，面部和臀部皮肤裸露为粉红色，尾中等长度。
field_marks.en: Yellowish to grey-brown with bare pinkish face and rump skin and a medium-length tail.

story.zh: 猕猴与人类的共同祖先距今约 2500 万年。基因组比较是理解人类基因差异的重要参照。
story.en: Macaques and humans share a common ancestor around 25 million years ago. Comparative genomics with macaques is a key reference for understanding human genes.

notes.zh: 寺庙、山地与旅游景点常见，群体活动。
notes.en: Common at temples, hills and tourist sites, living in troops.

etiquette.zh: 不要喂食、不要露出食物、不要直视并露齿，包袋拉好。
etiquette.en: Do not feed or show food, avoid staring and baring teeth, and keep bags zipped.
